text: A watcher steps only issues with something to do (#514). It remembers the issue version each successful step observed, comment count included, and skips unchanged idle issues; comments, body edits and labels wake an issue on the next poll, and pending commands, ratified builds, unfinished plans of issues, watched pull requests and CI, failed reads and running or queued steps stay eligible. Timestamps have one-second resolution, so a recent bucket stays pending until a read starts more than a minute later. One closed-issue query replaces the five active-label queries, and repeated REST reads revalidate their ETags, reusing the cached body on 304 from a cache of at most 256 responses and 32 MiB, isolated by request and credential. gh exits nonzero for every status outside 2xx, 304 included, after printing the response, so reads take GitHub's status from what gh printed. On 2026-11-03 the App ran out of its 5,000 requests an hour because every 30-second poll stepped every open issue.
